purpose: Quantify where Synthetic worlds resemble or differ from reality and investigate uncertainty representations without converting similarity into truth admission.
statistical_rule: No single p-value or distance metric constitutes Reality truth. Report effect size/distance, sample support, temporal stability, and known dependence/clustering.
synthetic_calibration_rule: Tune or bracket Synthetic parameters only against prespecified reality summaries that are legally/source-authorized and temporally well-defined; never use candidate model performance to make the simulator easier for that candidate.

conformal_questions: Can a conformal object be defined without breaking the ordered-top3 joint probability contract?
What exchangeability or weaker validity assumptions are plausible under chronological drift?
Would rolling/weighted/adaptive conformal variants be required and how would validity be checked?
Does the method improve decision abstention/NO_BET quality rather than merely widen sets?
uncertainty_research.allowed_current_use: design compatibility tests on toy/synthetic/non-protected data only

NO_BET_role: Uncertainty and severe missingness may support abstention research, but NO_BET thresholds must be prespecified before evaluation and cannot be tuned on protected final outcomes.
next_gate: Build reality-summary schema and uncertainty compatibility tests; then bind only source-authorized non-protected real summaries.
